description: Search HourSaved's ready-to-send customer messages for small businesses by situation, for example "dog walking client cancelled last minute", "raise my prices", "client hasn't paid the invoice" or "angry one-star review". Optionally narrow to one kind of business. Returns up to 8 matches with their ids and page links.
